def transform(value):
    if not isinstance(value,str): return None
    n=value.rsplit('/',1)[-1]
    if '.' not in n or n.endswith('.') or (n.startswith('.') and n.count('.')==1): return None
    return n.rsplit('.',1)[1].lower() or None

Use the last slash-separated path component as the filename.
